## Concepts and intuitions {.unnumbered}

## Formal {.unnumbered}

$$
    y \sim N(a x + b, \sigma^2)
$${#eq-lm}

## Examples {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: false
#| fig-cap: "Simple Linear Model Analysis"
#| label: fig-lm-analysis

# Create sample data with linear relationship
set.seed(456)
n <- 50
x <- seq(1, 10, length.out = n)
y <- 2 + 1.5 * x + rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 2)

# Create data frame
lm_data <- data.frame(x = x, y = y)

# Fit simple linear model: y ~ a + b*x
lm_model <- lm(y ~ x, data = lm_data)

# Display model summary
print("Linear Model Summary:")
print(summary(lm_model))

# Extract key statistics
coef_intercept <- coef(lm_model)[1]
coef_slope <- coef(lm_model)[2]
r_squared <- summary(lm_model)$r.squared
adj_r_squared <- summary(lm_model)$adj.r.squared
p_value <- summary(lm_model)$coefficients[2, 4]

print(paste("Intercept (a):", round(coef_intercept, 4)))
print(paste("Slope (b):", round(coef_slope, 4)))
print(paste("R-squared:", round(r_squared, 4)))
print(paste("Adjusted R-squared:", round(adj_r_squared, 4)))
print(paste("p-value for slope:", round(p_value, 6)))

# Prediction for new data
new_x <- data.frame(x = c(3, 5, 7))
predictions <- predict(lm_model, newdata = new_x, interval = "confidence", level = 0.95)
print("\nPredictions with 95% confidence intervals:")
print(cbind(new_x, predictions))
```

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: false
#| fig-cap: "Scatterplot with Fitted Line and Confidence Interval"
#| label: fig-lm-plot

# Create scatter plot with fitted line
plot(lm_data$x, lm_data$y,
     main = "Simple Linear Model: y ~ 1 + 1.5*x",
     xlab = "x",
     ylab = "y",
     pch = 19,
     col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.6),
     cex = 1.2)

# Add fitted line
x_line <- seq(min(lm_data$x), max(lm_data$x), length.out = 100)
y_line <- predict(lm_model, newdata = data.frame(x = x_line))
lines(x_line, y_line, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 1)

# Add confidence interval
pred_interval <- predict(lm_model, newdata = data.frame(x = x_line), 
                        interval = "confidence", level = 0.95)
lines(x_line, pred_interval[, 2], col = "red", lwd = 1, lty = 2)
lines(x_line, pred_interval[, 3], col = "red", lwd = 1, lty = 2)

# Add legend
legend("topleft", 
       legend = c("Observed data", "Fitted line", "95% CI"),
       col = c("blue", "red", "red"),
       pch = c(19, NA, NA),
       lty = c(NA, 1, 2),
       lwd = c(NA, 2, 1),
       cex = 0.9)

# Add equation to plot
equation_text <- paste("y =", round(coef_intercept, 2), "+", round(coef_slope, 2), "* x",
                       "\nR² =", round(r_squared, 4))
text(max(lm_data$x) * 0.55, min(lm_data$y) + 2, equation_text, 
     cex = 1, col = "darkred", font = 2)
```

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: false
#| fig-cap: "Diagnostic Plots for Linear Model"
#| label: fig-lm-diagnostics

# Set up 2x2 panel layout for diagnostic plots
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))

# Plot diagnostic plots from the linear model
plot(lm_model)

# Reset plot layout
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
